name: Learning
overview: Scripture emphasizes that true learning begins with the fear of the LORD, which is the foundation of knowledge and wisdom, as Proverbs 1:7 teaches. A wise and understanding person actively seeks to increase learning by listening and embracing instruction (Proverbs 1:5; 9:9; 18:15). Believers are called to not only learn sound doctrine but also to put it into practice, as exemplified in Philippians 4:9 and Titus 2:1, demonstrating that learning is both a continual growth process and a call to live according to God's truth.
